data.name: Lasting Breath
data.description: You can touch an ally to bless it with an extra reserve of breath. For 1 minute, while the ally holds its breath, standard and full-round actions don't decrease the number of rounds the ally can hold its breath (see page 445 of Pathfinder RPG Core Rulebook).
